qs.q: The units responsible for the efficient organisation of search and rescue are:
o: Area control centres, flight information centres and rescue coordination centres
Rescue coordination centres and rescue sub-centres
Alerting centres and rescue coordination centres

qs.q: Three aircraft arrive ten minutes apart over a recent accident: (1) cannot contact the SAR centre, (2) can, and (3) is a SAR helicopter. Who has on-scene command?
o: (1), then by mutual consent (2) until operations are complete
qs.ex: The first aircraft takes charge and may hand over to one that can contact the RCC.
